main.description: Publicly looks up one indexed contributor-information record by exact AT-URI and includes its publisher.

uri.description: Full contributor-information record AT-URI with a DID authority.

errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No indexed contributor-information record exists at this AT-URI.

errors.name: ContributorInformationQueryFailed
